title: Two to Contango
summary:
Two to Contango
The continued decline in the price of crude oil has created opportunities for market players. Crude oil forward price structures generally occur in two forms: backwardation is when the physical spot price is higher than the future price and contango is when the physical spot price is lower than the future price. Although the market has experienced varying degrees of contango in 2008, the differential has been more pronounced in recent weeks.

Charterers will pay in the range of $55,000 per day in today's market for a storage period of approximately three to six months.
